name: awesome-offline-mobile-games
description: Fourteen deep offline games for phones: six open-source ports rebuilt from pinned source, four originals built here on real sprites, audio and game data, and four cross-hybrids that cross one clone's systems with another's under a new name. No accounts, no ads, no network.

scripts.build: node tools/sync-catalog.mjs --check && node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/vendor.mjs && node tools/stage-dist.mjs
scripts.ios:payload: npm run build && npm run ios:stage && npm run ios:check
scripts.test: node tools/sync-catalog.mjs --check && node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/vendor.mjs && python3 tools/ports-provenance.py --check && node tests/browser.mjs && node tests/touch.mjs && node tests/offline.mjs && node tests/longrun.mjs
